description: Change any subset of a form's settings: name, purpose, allowedDomains, redirectUrl, spamMode, active, storeSubmissions, validation rules, blocklist, autoResponder (Pro).

blocklist.description: Emails, @domains or keywords that mark a submission as spam

redirectUrl.description: Absolute URL visitors are sent to after submitting

spamMode.description: How hard this form filters: minimal (nothing is filtered, paid plans only), relaxed (flag but always deliver), standard, strict. Abuse protection — rate limits, honeypot — is unaffected.

validation.description: Server-side rules by field, e.g. { "email": { "required": true, "type": "email" }, "message": { "minLength": 10 } }. null clears.

name: update_form
title: Update form settings
